identity_findings.failure_mode: Package execution_ref names codex/fc00x-resource-manifest-p12-v0-2, but that ref does not exist; the reviewed branch is codex/fc00x-resource-manifest-p12.
identity_findings.impact: A later executor could resolve the wrong checkout or fail to reproduce the reviewed package.
identity_findings.resolution: Use the exact existing branch/ref or create the named ref under the authorized repository before relying on the package.

findings.failure_mode: The digest stream cannot be uniquely encoded: u32(32) precedes a 28-byte domain string, manifest_revision inclusion is unspecified, and entry/tombstone presence bytes are incomplete.
findings.impact: Cross-platform replay, Snapshot restore and corruption detection can produce different Document identities.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: ADR-0020 requires verifiable digest and atomic restore; G1 projection-first verification does not freeze product digest bytes.
findings.unique_detection_value: Independent byte-stream differential over legacy-empty, explicit-empty, revision-only, tombstone and metadata-presence cases.
findings.why_not_covered: v0.2 added prose without byte-level closure.

findings.failure_mode: Snapshot fields 4..9 can form contradictory accepted states; revision/frontier/digest ownership and legacy omission rules are incomplete.
findings.impact: Restore may accept different checkpoints or reject legitimate legacy snapshots.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: ADR-0020 requires revision/frontier joint validation and atomic publication.
findings.unique_detection_value: Field-presence matrix for absent/empty/malformed manifest, omitted fields 5..9, digest mismatch and revision/frontier permutations.
findings.why_not_covered: Current snapshot.proto has only fields 1..3 and the v0.2 binding remained candidate-only.

findings.failure_mode: Registry names metadata schemas but defines no fields, required presence, canonicalization, count limits or per-kind validation.
findings.impact: Malformed metadata can enter canonical state and cause cross-platform decode/layout divergence or resource exhaustion.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: RM-VALUE requires registry normalization; no accepted ResourceKind registry exists.
findings.unique_detection_value: Per-kind schema and malformed/oversize boundary corpus.
findings.why_not_covered: v0.2 registry only listed names, versions and maximum metadata bytes.

findings.failure_mode: A removed ResourceId can be recreated or Undo/Redo can restore a different preimage because lineage format, preimage retention, concurrent undo and compaction are unspecified.
findings.impact: Identity aliasing, replay divergence and recovery/collaboration corruption.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: ADR-0013 stable identity and ADR-0014 controlled preimage/compensating Operations.
findings.unique_detection_value: Remove/recreate, concurrent update/undo, redo-after-undo and compaction/recovery corpus.
findings.why_not_covered: v0.2 added tombstone prose but no executable lineage/preimage fields or oracle.

findings.failure_mode: The candidate requires removing object references and a manifest entry in one staged atomic operation, but UpdateResourceManifest has no reference-removal payload or cross-object transaction contract.
findings.impact: Dangling references, partial remove and mixed semantic generations.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: 07-03 freezes whole-operation atomicity, not a global multi-operation transaction.
findings.unique_detection_value: Live-reference removal and same-intent reference+manifest delete rejection/no-partial-publication tests.
findings.why_not_covered: v0.2 asserted staged atomicity without defining an executable payload or owner.
findings.owner: P12/P13 Operation authority reconciled with 07 runtime data flow

findings.failure_mode: ResourceId ChangeSet flags, before/after nullability, ordering, merge and consumer handling are not frozen.
findings.impact: Incremental refresh can miss resources, publish mixed revisions or diverge from full/recovery Scene.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: ADR-0019 separation and current ObjectSemanticChange model.
findings.unique_detection_value: Multi-operation same-generation merge/order corpus plus full/delta/recovery equivalence.
findings.why_not_covered: v0.2 explicitly left exact fields and merge/order open.

findings.failure_mode: Legacy capability name/window and schema field omission rules differ between context, registry and readers.
findings.impact: Readers can disagree on absent/empty/malformed manifests or retain legacy mode indefinitely.
findings.existing_independent_coverage: RM-LEGACY matrix and candidate capability registry.
findings.unique_detection_value: Absent/explicit-empty/malformed, unknown capability and rewrite-boundary tests.
findings.why_not_covered: The registry remained candidate-only and lacked per-schema expiry semantics.
